name: Copenhagen Photo Festival 2025
description:
Billetsalget åbner 1. februar · Ticket sale opens 1 February 

 English text below 

 Oplev fotografi i verdensklasse på årets fotofestival i København, der i år foregår i helt nye rammer centralt i byen. Her kan du opleve en stribe udstillinger, der udfolder dybden af samtidsfotografiet fra stjernefotograf til vækstlag. 

 I 2025 har festivalen for første gang indbudt en international stjernefotograf til at være årets absolutte highlight. 

 Sideløbende kan publikum opleve soloudstillinger med fire internationale fotografer, der er blevet udvalgt blandt 1000 ansøgere i et open call i efteråret 2024. De bliver annonceret i marts.

 I festivalens centrum kan man desuden opleve talks, guidede ture, engagerende aktiviteter, et fotoprintmarked samt et to-dages fotobogmarked. 

 Det hele bliver skudt igang med en Grand Opening den 12. juni. 

 Festivalen løber frem til den 22. juni og kan også opleves på en række museer og udstillingssteder rundt om i København og omegn. 

 YDERLIGERE INFO OM NY VENUE OG KUNSTNERE BLIVER OFFENTLIGGJORT FRA 1. FEBRUAR PÅ FESTIVALENS HJEMMESIDE. 

 NB! Udstillingerne i festivalens centrum vil kun være åbent i perioden 12.-18. juni. Billetten giver dagsadgang til udstillinger og markeder i festivalens centrum. Billetter til særarrangementer, fx. talks og guidede ture kræver særskilt billet. 

 Adgang til udstillinger hos vores festivalpartnere på museer mv., som kræver entré, er ikke indeholdt i denne billet. 

 ______________

 Experience world-class photography at Copenhagen Photo Festival 2025, which this year takes place in a completely new venue in the heart of the city. Here you can experience a series of exhibitions that unfold the depth of contemporary photography from star photographers to emerging talent. 

 In 2025, the festival has invited an international star photographer for the first time to be the absolute highlight of the year. 

 At the same time, the audience can experience solo exhibitions with four international photographers who have been selected from 1,000 applicants in an open call in the fall of 2024. 

 The festival center will also host talks, guided tours, engaging activities, a photo print market and a two-day photo book market. 

 It all kicks off with a Grand Opening on June 12th. 

 The festival runs until June 22nd and can also be experienced at a number of museums and exhibition venues around Copenhagen and the surrounding area. 

 DETAILED INFORMATION ABOUT THE NEW VENUE AND ARTISTS WILL BE AVAILABLE ON FEBRUARY 1ST ON THE FESTIVAL'S WEBSITE 

 NB! The exhibitions in the festival center are only open from June 12-18. The ticket gives one day access to the exhibitions ands markets at the festival center. 

 Tickets for special events, e.g. talks and guided tours require a separate ticket. 

 Access to exhibitions at our festival partners at museums which require admission, is not included in this ticket and must be bought at the individual venues. 

 

 Foto/photo: Camilla Winther
